hero.summary: Trail turns messy tab sessions into structured trails. Keep every decision, source, and next step in one place. It is a paid extension with a simple subscription when you are ready to unlock more.

features.title: Everything you need to stay in flow.
features.summary: Trail is designed to feel invisible while you browse, but incredibly powerful when you need to pick a trail back up.

cards.title: Auto-captured trails
cards.copy: Every search, doc, and decision is logged into a clean trail you can resume in seconds.

cards.title: Smart tagging
cards.copy: Trail tags pages as you browse, so you can filter by topic, client, or research thread.

cards.title: Shareable context
cards.copy: Send a trail instead of a tab dump. Keep the storyline, notes, and decisions intact.

workflow.title: A calm trail from search to share.
workflow.summary: Your session stays organized without extra clicks. Trail captures the path, helps you curate the best moments, and keeps everything ready for next time.

steps.title: Capture
steps.copy: Trail runs as a lightweight browser extension, recording every meaningful step in your session.

steps.title: Curate
steps.copy: Highlight key sources, add notes, and pin the moments that matter before you move on.

steps.title: Resume
steps.copy: Open a trail later and you are back exactly where you left off, complete with context.

steps.title: Share
steps.copy: Send a trail to collaborators so they can jump into the same research path instantly.

dataset.title: A trail is a dataset.
dataset.summary: Every trail captures the intent, the sources, and the decisions behind your work. Use it to report, onboard, or restart the next morning with zero friction.
dataset.subscriptionSummary: Trail is a paid browser extension. Upgrade once, unlock unlimited trails, deeper analytics, and team-ready sharing.

faq.title: Questions, answered.
faq.summary: Everything you need to know about Trail subscriptions and how the extension works.

items.question: Is Trail a cloud product?
items.answer: No. Trail is a paid browser extension. Your subscription unlocks premium features and sync options.

items.question: Does it work offline?
items.answer: Yes. Trails are captured locally and can sync when you are back online.

items.question: Can I export or share trails?
items.answer: You can export summaries or share a private link with teammates.

items.question: Is there a free plan?
items.answer: Start free, then upgrade to unlock unlimited trails and advanced insights.
